nativeLanguageSearches.exactQuery: Кадастри давлатии Тоҷикистон харитаи кадастрии Душанбе қитъаи замин geoportal WFS
nativeLanguageSearches.summary: Search result for the official Real Estate Registration geoportal describes public map layers for locating a house/land parcel/object, administrative/address identification, a graphical plan that can represent parcel boundaries and geometry, and free information. Direct open of the portal returned an internal error in this research channel; no viewer code, service URL, bounded query or geometry could be inspected.

nativeLanguageSearches.exactQuery: Таджикистан геопортал кадастр земельных участков Душанбе WFS кадастровая карта
nativeLanguageSearches.summary: Official geoportal surfaced again. A separate Tajik infrastructure GIS is an unrelated project-monitoring map; its visible thematic categories are education, health, energy, water, transport, environment, sports and culture, not land parcels.

officialAndRelevantLeads.operator: State Enterprise for Registration of Real Estate / Tajikistan Geoportal (as identified by official portal results)
officialAndRelevantLeads.observation: Indexed Tajik-language portal describes location of land parcels and building footprints, graphical plans including parcel boundary/geometry, parcel address and cadastral number. It states information provided to legal and natural persons is free. Actual endpoint and direct anonymous map access could not be verified because page open returned an internal error.

officialAndRelevantLeads.operator: National Infrastructure Support Fund of Tajikistan (NSIFT)
officialAndRelevantLeads.observation: Interactive GIS for infrastructure projects with visible service-sector categories; not cadastral parcel evidence.

officialAndRelevantLeads.operator: State Unitary Enterprise for Registration of Real Estate, as identified on its homepage
officialAndRelevantLeads.observation: Reachable official service site (HTTP 200); the homepage links its Geoportal entry to https://geoportal.tj/ and links the State Committee for Land Management and Geodesy at https://www.zamin.tj. It exposes institutional/service pages but no alternative parcel feature endpoint.

officialAndRelevantLeads.operator: State Committee for Land Management and Geodesy of the Republic of Tajikistan (as labeled by the registration-service site)
officialAndRelevantLeads.observation: Officially linked from baqaydgiri.tj, but its HTTPS hostname failed default certificate verification (expired certificate); ordinary HTTP redirects to the same HTTPS hostname. No page or endpoint was inspected.

requestsAndEndpointChecks.assessment: Redirects to https://geoportal.tj/. The destination then fails certificate verification because the certificate is expired; TLS verification was not disabled.
Redirects to https://www.geoportal.tj/. HTTPS on that exact alias also fails default certificate verification because the certificate is expired; no TLS bypass.

Official registration-service homepage links directly to the Geoportal and the State Committee for Land Management and Geodesy site; it publishes no alternate map service endpoint or parcel response on the landing page.

requestsAndEndpointChecks.assessment: Officially linked from baqaydgiri.tj but inaccessible without disabling TLS verification. Its corresponding HTTP root redirects (303) to HTTPS, so no content was inspected.

requestsAndEndpointChecks.method: GET with a per-request certificate-verification exception
requestsAndEndpointChecks.assessment: Public polygon-layer metadata verified. Subsequent feature/count queries fail, including from a second network; see the linked diagnostic for every request.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Public Tajikistan real-estate geoportal; its Dushanbe-specific OLD_DATA layer declares an approximately 29 by 29 km extent around the city.

blocker: A per-request TLS certificate exception reaches the public portal, web map and OLD_DATA Dushanbe parcel-layer metadata. Actual count, spatial and object-ID reads return ArcGIS error 400 through both FeatureServer and MapServer, including on a second network. CADASTR_NEW parcel-layer metadata times out after 55 seconds locally and 80 seconds on the second network despite a completed TLS handshake. No nonempty parcel response was obtained; the evidence points to a provider-side data-service failure whose exact internal cause is unexposed. The certificate exception is working.
remainingUncertainty: Actual parcel geometry, geometry quality, present data coverage, cadastral-code values/uniqueness/repeatability, parcel update dates and reuse terms remain unverified. The portal/public service metadata and its declared parcel schema are now confirmed.
nextStep: Retry the published OLD_DATA/OLD_DATA/FeatureServer/6 and MapServer/6 queries, plus CADASTR/CADASTR_NEW/FeatureServer/1, after the service recovers. A source-specific certificate exception is authorized; normal certificate validation remains the default. After obtaining polygons, audit local coverage, validity/overlaps, cadastral-code availability and repeatability before enabling the source.
publicEndpointVerificationScope: Anonymous service metadata only; no successful nonempty feature query.
